label: thm:ew-triplet-charge-spin-from-involution
title: Charge and spin of the electroweak triplet are forced by the spin-involution sector selection
html:
Theorem (conditional on the electroweak sector-selection postulate). Fix the categorical coefficient ring R (a field with \tfrac{1}{2} \in R) and the sector-selection postulate: each electroweak carrier is assigned to the spin-singlet sector A_+ (\sigma-fixed, bar-even) or the spin-doublet sector A_- (\sigma-negated, bar-odd) of the spin involution \sigma, with H the singlet and W^\pm, Z the doublets, together with the isospin label map T_3(W^\pm) = \pm 1, T_3(Z) = T_3(H) = 0. Then the spin and charge of the triplet are determined:

  \mathrm{spin}(H) = 0 \ (\text{scalar, neutral}), \qquad
  \mathrm{spin}(W^\pm) = \mathrm{spin}(Z) = 1 \ (\text{vector}),
  T_3(W^\pm) = \pm 1 \ (\text{charged}), \qquad T_3(Z) = 0 \ (\text{neutral}).

Charge and spin are not independent open conjectures: both follow from the one physics selection postulate through the spin involution.
heading: Theorem
